Sam T.: Quick heads-up — running go-live dry-run for new Snowflake + Databricks + Qdrant connector next Wed 10am PT. Need cross-team alignment and marketplace packaging review. :calendar: :rocket:
Elaine R.: Copy — I'll block 10-11. Can you drop the runbook link?
Sam T.: https://redwood.ai/partnerships/connector-dry-run — draft runbook, tests, and rollback steps. Please @Vivian K. for compliance sign-off.
Vivian K.: Thx. I'll skim this afternoon. Need to confirm data residency note for EU customers. Also legal needs to approve Marketplace listing copy.
Diego M.: From infra: staging cluster is ready in us-west-2, gpu nodes pinned to g5x. Can we get sample dataset + ingest script?
Sam T.: Uploading sample to GH repo now: https://github.com/redwood/partner-connectors/snow-dbx-qdrant/tree/dryrun
Sam T.: Ingest snippet (run in staging):
```
./connector --source snowflake://acct/db --sink qdrant://staging:6333 --batch-size 512 --auth-token $TOKEN
```
Prashant P.: Vector compatibility check: qdrant + milvus embeddings mapping OK? For Milvus we'll need dim=1536 support in connector v1.2.0.
Elaine R.: Noted. @marketplace-bot can you list the packaging checklist we need for marketplace (icons, pricing tiers, listing doc)?
marketplace-bot: Packaging checklist posted: /marketplace/partner-packaging.md — include logo (SVG), 1-page summary, tested regions, SLA tier, review contact.
Sam T.: Can engineering pledge a 24h on-call during the dry-run window? Requesting a 1hr post-run retro with partners.
Diego M.: I can cover on-call. Will monitor tail latency and KV-cache warmup. I'll post metrics to the runbook dashboard.
Vivian K.: Legal asked for copy of data processing addendum for partner to sign. @Sam T. please send PDF by EOD.
Sam T.: Will do. Also want to run one canary traffic pattern: 5% production-like queries for 30m, watch fallback to cpu-quantized model if gpu saturates.
Prashant P.: Add note: quantized fallback increases p95 by ~80ms, documented in runbook.
Elaine R.: Great — I'll handle announcement cadence draft + press snippet. Aim to coordinate with partner comms team Tue COB.
Sam T.: Awesome. If anyone has blockers, reply here. Otherwise I'll push final runbook by Mon EOD.
